description:
Create a text-based highlight on a specific page.

Use this after reading page content with highlyt_get_page_text.
The highlight will appear in the sidebar and be searchable/exportable.
Copy the exact text from the page content for the 'text' field.

params.description: Parameters for creating a text-based highlight.

color.description: Color hex. Use document's color definitions: amber (#E5A84B) for core ideas, sage (#6BBF8A) for action items, sky (#5BA3D9) for questions/exploration

comment.description: Note or annotation for the highlight

page_number.description: Page number where the text appears (1-indexed)

text.description: The exact text to highlight (copy from page content)

name: highlyt_create_text_highlight
title: Create Text Highlight
